FreeObjectPose.title: FreeObjectPose

GoalType.title: GoalType

GraspSpec.description:
Externally generated grasp hypothesis passed through to motion planning.

Task Planner treats ``pose`` and the optional approach/contact payloads as
opaque data.  It only preserves grasp identity and ownership so that the
motion planner can resolve the correct geometry without inspecting ad-hoc
candidate metadata.
GraspSpec.title: GraspSpec

KeyframePlanCandidate.title: KeyframePlanCandidate

MotionGoal.description: Grounded geometric target; manipulation meaning lives on MotionTask.
MotionGoal.title: MotionGoal

MotionPlan.description: Internal executable artifact consumed directly by the simulator.
MotionPlan.title: MotionPlan

MotionPlanRequest.description: One-way Task Planner -> Motion Planner trajectory-generation command.
MotionPlanRequest.title: MotionPlanRequest

MotionTask.description: One executable motion task grounded by Task Planner.
MotionTask.title: MotionTask

Pose.description: Rigid pose in SI units; quaternion order is x, y, z, w.
Pose.title: Pose

RecoveryDirective.description: Recovery Orchestrator command: rerun only the root-cause module.
RecoveryDirective.title: RecoveryDirective

RelativeKeyframeSpec.description:
Symbolic keyframe resolved deterministically against a scene frame.

A VLM selects a frame, named anchor, approach axis, offset, and roll.  It
never emits a world-frame position or a free-form quaternion.
RelativeKeyframeSpec.title: RelativeKeyframeSpec

RobotState.description: Complete state required to initialize or verify trajectory playback.

SimulationRun.description: Internal command that binds an exact plan to simulator settings.

StrategyGenerationProvenance.description: Identity that freezes a stochastic strategy proposal as an artifact.
StrategyGenerationProvenance.title: StrategyGenerationProvenance

TrajectoryEvent.description: Discrete command synchronized to the trajectory clock.

TrajectorySegment.description: Semantically labelled, collision-checked part of the trajectory.
TrajectorySegment.title: TrajectorySegment

WorldSnapshot.description: Atomic world and robot state used as the planning start state.
